# `morphir mck workbench check`

- **Usage:** `morphir mck workbench check <--kit <DIR>> <--report <FILE>>`

Recompute qualification from every saved observation and the independent corpus

## Flags
- **`--kit <DIR>`** — Independent Workbench corpus directory containing cases.json
- **`--report <FILE>`** — Saved Workbench JSON evidence; its claimed results are independently recomputed
